description: This is a PHP class defining the 'ClaimExpense' entity for an expense claim management system. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes properties like expense type, date, amount, note, associated claim request, and deletion status. It also incorporates a decorator pattern via traits.

classes.name: ClaimExpense
classes.description: Entity class representing an expense claim item, with ORM mappings and accessor/mutator methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the expense record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the expense record.

methods.name: getExpenseType
methods.description: Retrieves the ExpenseType associated with this claim expense.

methods.name: setExpenseType
methods.description: Sets the ExpenseType for this claim expense.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with the expense.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date for the expense.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the amount of the expense.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount of the expense.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any note attached to the expense.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for the expense.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the ClaimRequest associated with this expense.

methods.name: setClaimRequest
methods.description: Associates a ClaimRequest with this expense.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the expense is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the expense as deleted or not.
